# Configuration reference

Every key monocarve accepts, generated from the zod schema in `src/config/schema*.ts`
(`monocarveConfigSchema`). Unknown keys are rejected at every level. Types are
the input shape you write; defaults are applied when a key is omitted. Nested
keys are written relative to their top-level key: `[]` is an array element and
`<key>` is a record entry.

## Config files

monocarve discovers its config by walking upward from the working directory
(or `--cwd`) and takes the first match, in this precedence order, in the
nearest directory that has one. `--config <path>` names a file explicitly.

- `monocarve.config.ts`
- `monocarve.config.mts`
- `monocarve.config.js`
- `monocarve.config.mjs`
- `monocarve.config.json`

Executable configs (`.ts`, `.mts`, `.js`, `.mjs`) default-export the config
object; `defineConfig` from `monocarve/config` is an identity helper that gives
editors completion and type errors. JSON configs contain the object itself.

## Minimal example

The required keys are `applications`, `packageRoots`, `scaffoldTemplates`; everything else has a default.

```ts
import { defineConfig } from "monocarve/config";

export default defineConfig({
  applications: [{ name: "web", sourceRoot: "apps/web/src", tsconfig: "apps/web/tsconfig.json" }],
  packageRoots: ["libs"],
  scaffoldTemplates: { packageJson: { file: "tools/monocarve/package.json.tpl" } },
});
```

## Adapters

| key              | supported values   | default  |
| ---------------- | ------------------ | -------- |
| `packageManager` | `"pnpm"`, `"bun"`  | `"pnpm"` |
| `taskRunner`     | `"moon"`, `"none"` | `"none"` |

Also recognized but refused at load time as not yet supported: `npm`, `yarn`, `nx`, `turbo`.

## Top-level keys

| key                        | type                     | default                                                          | required | description                                                                                                 |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `applications`             | `object[]`               |                                                                  | yes      | Applications whose code can be carved into packages; at least one.                                          |
| `assetEmissionProofs`      | `object[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Optional repository build proofs that emitted, tree-shaken assets survive a move.                           |
| `assetExtensions`          | `string[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Non-TypeScript extensions treated as movable assets that travel byte-identical with their closure.          |
| `campaignDir`              | `string`                 | `".monocarve/campaigns"`                                         | no       | Git-ignored directory for mutable campaign ledgers.                                                         |
| `commitTemplates`          | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Conventional Commit subjects and trailer for the commits `apply` creates.                                   |
| `compositionBoundaries`    | `object[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Frontend boundary preparations: replace an app shim with a package, or split a contract from its adapter.   |
| `cssImportExtensions`      | `string[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Asset extensions whose files use ordered CSS `@import` syntax; each must also be an asset extension.        |
| `dependencyPruning`        | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Report or remove donor dependencies left unused by an extraction.                                           |
| `extractionProfiles`       | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Named package-kind profiles with destination, naming, scaffold, and gate overrides.                         |
| `firstPartyPackages`       | `object[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | First-party packages at an exact root, with a declared name for bare-specifier resolution.                  |
| `firstPartyRoots`          | `string[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | First-party roots that are neither applications nor package roots; imports into them are first-party edges. |
| `gates`                    | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Repository gate commands run after an extraction, by package, project, and workspace tier.                  |
| `generatedArtifacts`       | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Generated files that gates or generators produce and plans must declare.                                    |
| `generatedSourceAdoptions` | `object[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Reviewed adoptions of orphaned generated output as durable source.                                          |
| `graph`                    | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Dependency-graph scanning options.                                                                          |
| `guardedBranches`          | `string[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Branches on which `apply` refuses to commit.                                                                |
| `integrationTestSuites`    | `Record<string, object>` | `{}`                                                             | no       | Configured integration-test suites that `relocate-tests` can compile into leaf packages.                    |
| `modulePromotions`         | `object[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Reviewed promotions of one complete module to a byte-identical package surface.                             |
| `moduleSpecifierCalls`     | `string[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Qualified calls whose first argument is a module specifier, such as a mock API.                             |
| `packageManager`           | `"pnpm" \| "bun"`        | `"pnpm"`                                                         | no       | Package-manager adapter for workspace membership and lockfile operations; supported: `pnpm`, `bun`.         |
| `packageNamePattern`       | `string`                 |                                                                  | no       | Regex a generated package name must match; defaults to the scope followed by a kebab-case name.             |
| `packageRoots`             | `string[]`               |                                                                  | yes      | Directories holding workspace packages, in preference order; new packages go under the first.               |
| `packageScope`             | `string`                 | `""`                                                             | no       | npm scope prefix for generated package names, e.g. `@acme/`.                                                |
| `pathMigrations`           | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Commands that rewrite path-bearing artifacts after files move.                                              |
| `pathReferenceRewrites`    | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Rules for rewriting path-string references to moved files.                                                  |
| `pathReferences`           | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Static path-string references that must be tracked when files move.                                         |
| `planDir`                  | `string`                 | `".monocarve/plans"`                                             | no       | Where compiled plan manifests are written.                                                                  |
| `portPromotions`           | `object[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Backend boundary preparations that promote a port contract out of an application.                           |
| `portfolio`                | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Candidate domain, eligibility, scoring, and recommendation policy.                                          |
| `postJournalPreparers`     | `object[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Declared-output preparers that need the journal's moved tree; run before gates.                             |
| `preparation`              | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Repository-owned gates and commit policy for type-only declaration preparation.                             |
| `preparers`                | `object[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Repository-owned, declared-output commands or edits run before an extraction.                               |
| `root`                     | `string`                 | `"."`                                                            | no       | Repo root, relative to the config file; almost always `.`.                                                  |
| `runtimeModuleRegistries`  | `object[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | JSON-pointer fields in registry files whose module paths resolve from a declared root.                      |
| `scaffoldTemplates`        | `object`                 |                                                                  | yes      | Templates for the files scaffolded into a new workspace package.                                            |
| `sourceExtensions`         | `string[]`               | `[".ts", ".tsx", ".mts", ".cts", ".js", ".jsx", ".mjs", ".cjs"]` | no       | Source module extensions understood by this workspace's compiler policy.                                    |
| `taskRunner`               | `"moon" \| "none"`       | `"none"`                                                         | no       | Task-runner adapter for project files and gate invocation; supported: `moon`, `none`.                       |
| `testKinds`                | `object`                 |                                                                  | no       | Explicit test intent by path pattern; when present it replaces `testPathPatterns`.                          |
| `testPathPatterns`         | `string[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Regexes matching test files, which travel with their code as devDependencies.                               |
| `testRelocation`           | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | How co-located tests follow extracted modules: `all-importers` or `self-contained`.                         |
| `transaction`              | `object`                 | `{}`                                                             | no       | Simulation worktree, dirty-path, and gate-retry policy for applying plans.                                  |
| `valueSplits`              | `object[]`               | `[]`                                                             | no       | Reviewed extractions of one dependency-closed exported value SCC from a mixed module.                       |

## Nested keys

### `applications`

Applications whose code can be carved into packages; at least one.

| key                                                       | type                                                | default               | required   | description                                                                                                                            |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[].compilerProfile`                                      | `object`                                            | `{}`                  | no         | Ambient compilation surface (libs, types, JSX, resolution) the application's code expects.                                             |
| `[].compilerProfile.allowSyntheticDefaultImports`         | `boolean`                                           | `false`               | no         | Match the application's `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` setting.                                                                        |
| `[].compilerProfile.esModuleInterop`                      | `boolean`                                           | `false`               | no         | Match the application's `esModuleInterop` setting.                                                                                     |
| `[].compilerProfile.jsx`                                  | `boolean`                                           | `false`               | no         | Compile the proof fixture with `react-jsx` when the closure contains JSX.                                                              |
| `[].compilerProfile.lib`                                  | `string[]`                                          | `["lib.es2022.d.ts"]` | no         | TypeScript `lib` files for the compile proof, e.g. `lib.dom.d.ts`.                                                                     |
| `[].compilerProfile.moduleResolution`                     | `"nodenext" \| "bundler"`                           | `"nodenext"`          | no         | Module-resolution mode for the compile proof; must match the application's own tsconfig.                                               |
| `[].compilerProfile.types`                                | `string[]`                                          | `[]`                  | no         | Ambient `types` packages for the compile proof, e.g. `node` or `bun`.                                                                  |
| `[].compositionRoots`                                     | `string[]`                                          | `[]`                  | no         | Runtime composition files (entrypoints, DI wiring, route registries) that make a closure ineligible.                                   |
| `[].consumerRoots`                                        | `string[]`                                          | `[]`                  | no         | First-party directories that may consume this application's code but are never extraction donors.                                      |
| `[].description`                                          | `string`                                            |                       | no         | Free-form human description of the application.                                                                                        |
| `[].name`                                                 | `string`                                            |                       | yes        | Stable application identifier used on the CLI (`--app`) and in plan manifests.                                                         |
| `[].ownerRoot`                                            | `string`                                            |                       | no         | Workspace package directory owning the application; defaults to the parent of `sourceRoot`.                                            |
| `[].packageName`                                          | `string`                                            |                       | no         | Workspace package name of the application itself, used to target consumer rewrites.                                                    |
| `[].project`                                              | `string`                                            |                       | no         | Task-runner project id when it differs from `name`; feeds the `{project}` gate placeholder.                                            |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates`                                    | `object`                                            |                       | no         | Per-application scaffold overrides; unset keys fall back to the root `scaffoldTemplates`.                                              |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.devDependencies`                    | `Record<string, string>`                            |                       | no         | Replacement devDependencies added to every generated package.                                                                          |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.devDependenciesByDependency`        | `Record<string, Record<string, string>>`            |                       | no         | Replacement extra devDependencies keyed by an inferred dependency.                                                                     |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.extraFiles`                         | `Record<string, { contents } \| { file }>`          |                       | no         | Additional files to scaffold, keyed by package-relative path.                                                                          |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.extraFiles.<key>.contents`          | `string`                                            |                       | in variant | Inline template text.                                                                                                                  |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.extraFiles.<key>.file`              | `string`                                            |                       | in variant | Repo-relative file holding the template text.                                                                                          |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.packageJson`                        | `{ contents } \| { file }`                          |                       | no         | Replacement `package.json` template for generated packages.                                                                            |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.packageJson.contents`               | `string`                                            |                       | in variant | Inline template text.                                                                                                                  |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.packageJson.file`                   | `string`                                            |                       | in variant | Repo-relative file holding the template text.                                                                                          |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.projectReferences`                  | `object`                                            | `{}`                  | no         | Replacement tsconfig project-reference targets.                                                                                        |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.projectReferences.dependencyTarget` | `string`                                            | `"tsconfig.json"`     | no         | tsconfig file referenced in each inferred workspace dependency.                                                                        |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.projectReferences.target`           | `string`                                            | `"tsconfig.json"`     | no         | Package-local tsconfig that receives inferred workspace project references.                                                            |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.publicSurface`                      | `{ mode } \| { mode, keyTemplate, targetTemplate }` |                       | no         | Replacement public-surface mode for generated packages.                                                                                |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.publicSurface.mode`                 | `"barrel" \| "subpaths"`                            |                       | yes        | `"barrel"`: Export everything through the single entrypoint barrel. `"subpaths"`: Export each moved module as its own package subpath. |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.publicSurface.keyTemplate`          | `string`                                            |                       | in variant | Package export key template, e.g. `./{pathNoExtension}`.                                                                               |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.publicSurface.targetTemplate`       | `string`                                            |                       | in variant | Package export target template, e.g. `./src/{path}`.                                                                                   |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.taskFile`                           | `{ contents } \| { file }`                          |                       | no         | Replacement task-runner project file template.                                                                                         |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.taskFile.contents`                  | `string`                                            |                       | in variant | Inline template text.                                                                                                                  |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.taskFile.file`                      | `string`                                            |                       | in variant | Repo-relative file holding the template text.                                                                                          |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.tsconfig`                           | `{ contents } \| { file }`                          |                       | no         | Replacement `tsconfig` template for generated packages.                                                                                |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.tsconfig.contents`                  | `string`                                            |                       | in variant | Inline template text.                                                                                                                  |
| `[].scaffoldTemplates.tsconfig.file`                      | `string`                                            |                       | in variant | Repo-relative file holding the template text.                                                                                          |
| `[].sourceRoot`                                           | `string`                                            |                       | yes        | Repo-relative directory scanned for extractable code, e.g. `apps/web/src`.                                                             |
| `[].tsconfig`                                             | `string`                                            |                       | yes        | tsconfig that resolves this application's imports for the graph scanner.                                                               |

### `assetEmissionProofs`

Optional repository build proofs that emitted, tree-shaken assets survive a move.

| key             | type              | default | required | description                                                                   |
| --------------- | ----------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[].analyzer`   | `"css-selectors"` |         | yes      | Analyzer that compares the emitted assets; only `css-selectors` is supported. |
| `[].command`    | `string`          |         | yes      | Build command whose emitted assets are compared before and after the move.    |
| `[].extensions` | `string[]`        |         | yes      | Extensions of emitted asset files to analyze, each starting with a dot.       |
| `[].id`         | `string`          |         | yes      | Unique kebab-case identifier for this proof.                                  |
| `[].roots`      | `string[]`        |         | yes      | Repo-relative directories scanned for emitted assets after the command runs.  |

### `commitTemplates`

Conventional Commit subjects and trailer for the commits `apply` creates.

| key       | type     | default                                                            | required | description                                                                  |
| --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `move`    | `string` | `"refactor({package}): move {fileCount} files into {packageRoot}"` | no       | Subject of the pure-rename move commit.                                      |
| `plan`    | `string` | `"chore({package}): compile extraction plan {planId}"`             | no       | Subject of the commit that records the compiled plan manifest.               |
| `trailer` | `string` | `""`                                                               | no       | Text appended verbatim to every generated commit body, such as trailers.     |
| `wiring`  | `string` | `"refactor({package}): wire {package} into the workspace"`         | no       | Subject of the content commit: scaffolding, consumer rewrites, and lockfile. |

### `compositionBoundaries`

Frontend boundary preparations: replace an app shim with a package, or split a contract from its adapter.

| key                        | type                           | default | required | description                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[].appAdapter`            | `string`                       |         | no       | Application-owned file implementing the contract; required for `port`.                                                       |
| `[].contract`              | `string`                       |         | no       | Contract interface name; required for `port`.                                                                                |
| `[].contractModule`        | `string`                       |         | no       | Module declaring the contract interface; required for `port`.                                                                |
| `[].id`                    | `string`                       |         | yes      | Unique kebab-case boundary id, used with `boundary --id`.                                                                    |
| `[].packageImport`         | `string`                       |         | no       | Specifier the portable module uses to reach the contract; required for `port`.                                               |
| `[].replacement`           | `object`                       |         | no       | Replacement package and symbols; required for `existing-package`.                                                            |
| `[].replacement.specifier` | `string`                       |         | yes      | Package specifier consumers are rewritten to.                                                                                |
| `[].replacement.symbols`   | `string[]`                     |         | yes      | Exact symbols the replacement package must export.                                                                           |
| `[].retained`              | `string`                       |         | yes      | The application module that must not move; the retained edge being addressed.                                                |
| `[].retire`                | `boolean`                      | `false` | no       | Delete the shim once no importer remains.                                                                                    |
| `[].selective`             | `boolean`                      | `false` | no       | Rewrite only importers whose named imports are all covered by `replacement.symbols`.                                         |
| `[].strategy`              | `"existing-package" \| "port"` |         | yes      | `existing-package` rewrites shim consumers to a real package; `port` has portable code import a contract the app implements. |
| `[].symbols`               | `string[]`                     | `[]`    | no       | Exhaustive symbols the portable side may import through `packageImport`; required for `port`.                                |
| `[].template`              | `string`                       |         | no       | Id of a reviewed adapter template in `scaffoldTemplates.extraFiles`.                                                         |

### `dependencyPruning`

Report or remove donor dependencies left unused by an extraction.

| key    | type                  | default    | required | description                                                              |
| ------ | --------------------- | ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `keep` | `string[]`            | `[]`       | no       | Dependencies retained by repository policy even without import evidence. |
| `mode` | `"report" \| "apply"` | `"report"` | no       | Whether possible donor orphan dependencies are only reported or removed. |

### `firstPartyPackages`

First-party packages at an exact root, with a declared name for bare-specifier resolution.

| key       | type     | default | required | description                                              |
| --------- | -------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[].name` | `string` |         | yes      | Declared package name, e.g. `@acme/shared`.              |
| `[].root` | `string` |         | yes      | Workspace-relative directory that is the package itself. |

### `gates`

Repository gate commands run after an extraction, by package, project, and workspace tier.

| key              | type       | default   | required | description                                                              |
| ---------------- | ---------- | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `maxConcurrency` | `integer`  | `1`       | no       | Maximum commands run at once within one gate tier; tiers stay ordered.   |
| `package`        | `string[]` | `[]`      | no       | Gate commands run against the newly created package.                     |
| `project`        | `string[]` | `[]`      | no       | Gate commands run once per consuming application project.                |
| `timeoutMs`      | `integer`  | `1200000` | no       | Per-command gate timeout in milliseconds.                                |
| `workspace`      | `string[]` | `[]`      | no       | Whole-workspace gate commands such as lint, format, typecheck, and test. |

### `generatedArtifacts`

Generated files that gates or generators produce and plans must declare.

| key                        | type       | default                                             | required | description                                                                                          |
| -------------------------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `artifacts`                | `object[]` | `[]`                                                | no       | Declared generated files with their sources and regeneration commands.                               |
| `artifacts[].exemptReason` | `string`   |                                                     | no       | Why the audit cannot hash-check the file; when set, only the regeneration command is carried.        |
| `artifacts[].path`         | `string`   |                                                     | yes      | Repo-relative path of the generated file.                                                            |
| `artifacts[].regenerate`   | `string`   |                                                     | yes      | Shell command, run from the workspace root, that regenerates the file.                               |
| `artifacts[].source`       | `string`   |                                                     | yes      | Repo-relative path the file is generated from.                                                       |
| `artifacts[].triggers`     | `string[]` | `[]`                                                | no       | Regexes over moved paths that attach this artifact to a plan; empty means every extraction.          |
| `provenance`               | `object`   | `{}`                                                | no       | Header conventions used to recognize generated files and read their source and regeneration command. |
| `provenance.headerLines`   | `integer`  | `12`                                                | no       | Number of leading lines searched for provenance headers.                                             |
| `provenance.marker`        | `string`   | `"@generated\|DO NOT EDIT"`                         | no       | Regex that marks a file as generated when it matches one of the first `headerLines` lines.           |
| `provenance.regenerate`    | `string`   | `"^//\\s*Regenerate:\\s*(.+)$"`                     | no       | Header regex whose capture group 1 yields the regeneration command.                                  |
| `provenance.source`        | `string`   | `"^//\\s*Source(?:\\s+of\\s+truth)?\\s*:\\s*(.+)$"` | no       | Header regex whose capture group 1 yields the generating source path.                                |
| `timeoutMs`                | `integer`  | `300000`                                            | no       | Timeout for one regeneration command, in milliseconds.                                               |

### `pathReferenceRewrites`

Rules for rewriting path-string references to moved files.

| key                     | type                 | default    | required | description                                                                                                         |
| ----------------------- | -------------------- | ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `enabled`               | `boolean`            | `false`    | no       | Rewrite moved path literals under journal during apply.                                                             |
| `matchExtensionless`    | `boolean`            | `false`    | no       | Also rewrite literals naming a moved path without its extension.                                                    |
| `maxBytes`              | `integer`            | `524288`   | no       | Files larger than this many bytes are not rewritten.                                                                |
| `minSegments`           | `integer`            | `3`        | no       | Path segments a moved source must have before it is rewritten; must not be lower than `pathReferences.minSegments`. |
| `onAmbiguousMatch`      | `"refuse" \| "skip"` | `"refuse"` | no       | Refuse the plan, or skip and report, when one token matches two moved sources.                                      |
| `roots`                 | `object[]`           |            | no       | Trees scanned and rewritten, each with its extensions and matching mode.                                            |
| `roots[].extensions`    | `string[]`           |            | yes      | File extensions rewritten in `root`, each starting with a dot.                                                      |
| `roots[].mode`          | `"exact-path-token"` |            | yes      | Matching mode; only exact path tokens are rewritten.                                                                |
| `roots[].referenceBase` | `string`             |            | no       | Repo-relative base from which shorthand tokens in this tree are resolved.                                           |
| `roots[].root`          | `string`             |            | yes      | Repo-relative directory whose path literals may be rewritten.                                                       |

### `portfolio`

Candidate domain, eligibility, scoring, and recommendation policy.

| key                           | type       | default                                                      | required | description                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `compatibilityShimMinInbound` | `integer`  | `5`                                                          | no       | Minimum production fan-in before a pure re-export is reported as a compatibility shim.                                                  |
| `compositionAdjacentPatterns` | `string[]` | `[]`                                                         | no       | Extra workspace-specific composition-adjacent path regexes flagged for review.                                                          |
| `compositionRootPatterns`     | `string[]` | `[]`                                                         | no       | Regexes matching runtime composition files, in addition to each application's `compositionRoots`; closures containing one are rejected. |
| `domains`                     | `object[]` | `[]`                                                         | no       | Named domains, each defined by regexes over file paths; closures crossing domains are scored down.                                      |
| `domains[].name`              | `string`   |                                                              | yes      | Domain name reported by portfolio analysis.                                                                                             |
| `domains[].patterns`          | `string[]` |                                                              | yes      | Regexes matching the files that belong to this domain.                                                                                  |
| `equivalenceThreshold`        | `number`   | `0.95`                                                       | no       | Production-file Jaccard similarity at which near-identical candidates collapse into one group.                                          |
| `extracted`                   | `string[]` | `[]`                                                         | no       | Candidate ids already extracted; `next` and `backlog` skip them.                                                                        |
| `forbidTargetSuggestion`      | `"root"[]` | `[]`                                                         | no       | Target shapes a candidate may not resolve to; `root` classifies such candidates as preparation work.                                    |
| `frameworkPackages`           | `string[]` | `[]`                                                         | no       | Packages whose use marks a component as framework-coupled; scored down, never rejected on its own.                                      |
| `genericTargetSegments`       | `string[]` | `["root", "components", "src", "shared", "common", "utils"]` | no       | Directory names too generic to be useful package boundaries; advisory only.                                                             |
| `highFanOutThreshold`         | `integer`  | `8`                                                          | no       | Advisory outbound-import count at or above which a module is flagged as a hotspot.                                                      |
| `highInboundThreshold`        | `integer`  | `12`                                                         | no       | Advisory inbound-import count at or above which a module is flagged as a hotspot.                                                       |
| `maxFiles`                    | `integer`  | `120`                                                        | no       | Largest closure, in files, considered reviewable.                                                                                       |
| `maxRecommendedFiles`         | `integer`  |                                                              | no       | Advisory file count above which a candidate is not recommended.                                                                         |
| `maxRecommendedLines`         | `integer`  |                                                              | no       | Advisory line count above which a candidate is not recommended.                                                                         |
| `minFiles`                    | `integer`  | `2`                                                          | no       | Smallest closure, in files, considered a candidate.                                                                                     |
| `nestedDomainRoots`           | `string[]` | `[]`                                                         | no       | Directory prefixes, relative to an application `sourceRoot`, whose immediate children are each their own domain.                        |
| `protectedPaths`              | `string[]` |                                                              | no       | Files or directory trees a candidate must never move; a closure containing one is ineligible.                                           |
| `retainedRoots`               | `string[]` | `[]`                                                         | no       | Paths that must stay application-owned for now; candidates reaching them become preparation candidates with a generated recipe.         |
| `weights`                     | `object`   | `{}`                                                         | no       | Scoring weights; negative values penalize and the ranking is a plain sum.                                                               |
| `weights.consumerCount`       | `number`   | `10`                                                         | no       | Weight per consumer of the closure, counting both production importers and test importers.                                              |
| `weights.domainCrossing`      | `number`   | `-500`                                                       | no       | Weight applied once when a candidate's closure spans more than one configured `domains` entry.                                          |
| `weights.fileCount`           | `number`   | `5`                                                          | no       | Weight per file in the closure.                                                                                                         |
| `weights.lineCount`           | `number`   | `1`                                                          | no       | Weight per line of code in the closure, excluding lines already covered by a detected compatibility shim.                               |
| `weights.prerequisite`        | `number`   | `-12`                                                        | no       | Weight per existing workspace package the closure already depends on.                                                                   |
| `weights.rejection`           | `number`   | `-1000`                                                      | no       | Weight per blocking reason, large enough that no ineligible candidate outranks an eligible one.                                         |
| `weights.retainedEdge`        | `number`   | `-250`                                                       | no       | Weight per retained-root blocker, ranking preparation candidates below extractable ones.                                                |
| `weights.rewriteEscape`       | `number`   | `-100`                                                       | no       | Weight per import that escapes the closure and needs rewriting.                                                                         |
| `weights.runtimeCrossing`     | `number`   | `-300`                                                       | no       | Weight applied once when a candidate's closure spans more than one runtime domain.                                                      |
| `weights.testCoverage`        | `number`   | `50`                                                         | no       | Weight multiplied by the fraction (0-1) of the closure's files covered by travelling tests.                                             |

| `[].triggers`                                 | `string[]`                     | `[]`    | no       | Regexes over moved or rewritten paths that select this preparer; empty means every extraction. |

| key                        | type     | default | required | description                                                                          |
| -------------------------- | -------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `[].id`                    | `string` |         | yes      | Unique kebab-case boundary id, used with `boundary --id`.                            |
| `[].source`                | `string` |         | yes      | Repo-relative mixed module the value is split out of.                                |
| `[].symbol`                | `string` |         | yes      | Exported value whose dependency-closed declaration group is extracted.               |
| `[].target`                | `string` |         | yes      | Repo-relative module that receives the declaration group; must differ from `source`. |
| `[].targetModuleSpecifier` | `string` |         | yes      | Exact specifier the donor's compatibility re-export uses to reach `target`.          |
